# depmap tools

Dependency-map analysis tools for impact assessment across all domains

6 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `depmap_find_consumers`

Find all repos that depend on a given repo across every dependency-map domain.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [depmap/depmap_find_consumers.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/depmap/depmap_find_consumers.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repo_name` | string | yes | Repository alias to search for (case-sensitive exact match against the alias as it appears in _domains.json and in the "Depends On" column of Incoming Dependencies tables). |

## `depmap_get_cross_domain_graph`

Return all domain-to-domain edges as JSON records (source, target, dependency_count, types); no rendering — pass edges to your visualization tool of choice.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [depmap/depmap_get_cross_domain_graph.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/depmap/depmap_get_cross_domain_graph.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `source_domain` | string or array of string | no | Optional filter. |
| `target_domain` | string or array of string | no | Optional filter. |
| `min_count` | integer | no | Optional filter. |

## `depmap_get_domain_summary`

Retrieve the structured summary for a named dependency-map domain.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [depmap/depmap_get_domain_summary.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/depmap/depmap_get_domain_summary.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `domain_name` | string | yes | Name of the domain to retrieve (case-sensitive exact match against the domain name in _domains.json or the `name` field in the domain markdown file's YAML frontmatter). |

## `depmap_get_hub_domains`

Return the top-N domains ranked by cross-domain edge degree (out, in, or total); on-the-fly computation, no cache.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [depmap/depmap_get_hub_domains.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/depmap/depmap_get_hub_domains.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `top_n` | integer | no | Maximum number of hub domains to return. |
| `by` | string (one of: `out_degree`, `in_degree`, `total_degree`) | no | Metric used to rank domains. |

## `depmap_get_repo_domains`

Find all domains that a given repo participates in, with its role in each domain.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [depmap/depmap_get_repo_domains.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/depmap/depmap_get_repo_domains.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repo_name` | string | yes | Repository alias to look up (case-sensitive exact match against the alias as it appears in _domains.json participating_repos entries). |

## `depmap_get_stale_domains`

List domains older than N days (use days_threshold=0 for a full freshness inventory); sorted most-stale first.

- Permission: `query_repos`
- Source: [depmap/depmap_get_stale_domains.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/depmap/depmap_get_stale_domains.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `days_threshold` | integer | yes | Minimum number of days since last_analyzed to include a domain in the result. |
